description: Every traditional parallel between Sifra (Leviticus midrash) and the Talmud from Sefaria Mesorat haShas-style links. Use this as the catalog of where Lev/Sifra material is linked into Bavli.
source: Data/links*.csv (Category other side = Talmud; one side = Sifra)

how_to_use.simple: Open sifra_talmud_links_2026-07-18.tsv in a spreadsheet. Filter by parasha or tractate.
how_to_use.json: links[] each has sifra_raw, talmud_raw, lev_range_approx, parasha, tractate, daf.
how_to_use.lookup_sifra_section: Filter links where sifra_section == e.g. "Vayikra Dibbura d'Nedavah" for Lev 1–3 area.

limitations: Mesorat haShas = traditional parallel, not a guarantee of full verbatim quote.
lev_range_approx is by Sifra section, not a per-line verse ID.
Misses Talmud uses of same midrash style with no link edge in this CSV.
Does not include Yerushalmi unless labeled Talmud in Category.
